integrity_notes: Complete continuous-parameter proof and sharp step extremizers are supplied.
Golden-section numerical tests are corroborative and are not used as an infinite proof.
Independent verification and historical-priority certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three real distinct sites on their convex hull only; no many-node or multidimensional conclusion.
The precise sharp BV coefficient is analytic, but uninspected historical univariate shape-preservation literature leaves priority risk.
The method does not reproduce nonconstant affine functions, and no smooth-function approximation order is claimed.
title: Sharp bounded-variation stability of three-site Shepard interpolation and its mesh–power boundary layer
